verdict.rationale: Asana's docs broadly reference 'rule actions, webhooks, and API' as automation building blocks and AI Studio's 'no-code automations', and third-party tools like Zapier/n8n/Pipedream can add schedule-based triggers, but no evidence explicitly documents a native recurring/schedule trigger (e.g., cron-like or date-based rule trigger) for engineer-built workflows. missing for 10: explicit documentation of native time/schedule-based rule triggers, recurring task automation specifics, and any hands-on confirmation that a scheduled workflow can be built and runs reliably.
